_comment: A shelf holds projects without being one. Everything directly below a shelf is a project; anything deeper becomes a breadcrumb (client > project). Copy this file to config.json to change anything; the page writes its own changes there.
_zoom: Base scale of the page. Set this instead of zooming in the browser every time; keep the browser itself at 100% or the two multiply.
_project_lines: project_lines: your own line under a project's name, keyed by the project's identity (track:x, repo:host/owner/name, client:..., folder:x). It beats the track's goal, the README and the guess. The page writes it when you click a line.
_overrides: names: your label for a project, keyed by its resolved name. lines: your text for a session, keyed by provider:id — it also retitles that terminal tab. pinned: projects held at the top, in this order. assign: a session's project, keyed by provider:id, or a whole track's or repository's, keyed by its identity: it holds for sessions that start later. A project is named by its identity (track:x, repo:host/owner/name, folder:x) or by its plain name.
_stuck: The flag the chime reads: a busy session whose transcript has been silent this many minutes. A `waiting` session is flagged at once, whatever this says. The overview says Hung instead, by `hung_after_minutes`.
_hung: How long a busy session may go without a write, a CPU-using shell under it or a live background job before the overview counts it as not moving, and calls it Hung. A number of minutes more than nothing; anything else is 10.
_long_tool: While a tool call is running the transcript is silent, so silence proves nothing. Only a call outstanding this many minutes is worth mentioning, and it is shown as news, not as an alarm.
_waiting: A helper spawned by /btw sits in `waiting` for a few seconds. Only a question left unanswered this long is worth flagging.
_chime: Sound: a two-stroke chime when a session starts waiting on you, a single short tick when one finishes. Either sounds once, for whoever has just changed -- never for the ones already on screen when the page opens.
_ticket_repos: Repos whose tickets open in Claude from /ticket/<owner>/<repo>/<n>, each with the directory its Claude starts in.
